texts.value: Binds to the plus end of microtubules and regulates microtubule dynamics and microtubule organization. Promotes cytoplasmic microtubule nucleation and elongation. Required for normal structure of the microtubule cytoskeleton during interphase
Interacts with CLIP1, CLIP2, CKAP5, CLASP1, MAPRE1 and MAPRE3
Colocalizes with microtubules. Detected at the plus end of growing microtubules
Widely expressed with highest levels in adult liver, testis and ovary, and lowest levels in adult pancreas and spleen and in fetal brain
The N-terminus forms a two-stranded coiled coil
Is highly phosphorylated during mitosis, but not during interphase. The highly phosphorylated form does not localize at microtubule plus ends and does not interact with MAPRE1 or CKAP5
Belongs to the SLAIN motif-containing family
